critical_code_review_comments: Minor (dev-only): React dev warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' is emitted for select options in MyWork.js (PROGRESS_OPTIONS map at line 495). This is triggered by the runtime x-source instrumentation wrapping option children in a <span>. It does not affect production build behaviour but pollutes the console during development. Consider hard-coding option labels or using a Radix/shadcn Select if strict SSR/hydration cleanliness is desired.
MyWork.js is large (~636 lines). Consider extracting TaskCard, ExecutionPlan, TaskTrail, UpdateForm, PriorityScoreBars into /components/mywork/* modules for maintainability.

op-approval chip text is derived as `${approver_name} required` even when the task is completed - the code special-cases status === 'done' to say 'Approved' which works, but there is no visual differentiation for 'cancelled' status (still shows 'X required'). Consider handling that too.

STATUS_OPTIONS in MyWork.js hardcodes labels while backend accepts todo/in_progress/waiting/review/done/cancelled - keep this in sync if backend adds new statuses. Consider deriving from a shared constants module.
